answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because trellis only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, canyon is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any willow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
